name: Hahnenkamm
kurzbeschreibung: Kitzbühel's Hahnenkamm is the legendary home of the downhill Streif race and a sunny panoramic hiking mountain in summer.
beschreibung:
Overview

The world-famous Hahnenkamm rises to an altitude of 1,712 meters southwest of the glamorous alpine town of Kitzbühel, serving as the most legendary venue in international alpine ski racing. Every January, the sporting world focuses on the notorious "Streif" – regarded by athletes and fans as the most demanding, dangerous, and thrilling downhill racecourse on the entire World Cup circuit. Yet beyond the snowy winter months, when elite skiers race at speeds over 140 km/h past the Mausefalle and the steep pitch, the mountain attracts visitors all year round. In summer, the Hahnenkamm transforms into a gently rolling, sun-drenched hiking haven for nature lovers and families. At the summit, an exceptional 360-degree panorama unfolds, taking in the jagged limestone peaks of the Wilder Kaiser, the Kitzbüheler Horn, and the glaciated giants of the Hohe Tauern.

Route & Requirements

The ascent to the mountain plateau is swift and barrier-free via the modern red cabins of the Hahnenkammbahn, with each gondola bearing the name of a past Hahnenkamm race winner. Right beside the mountain station, the signposted "Summer Streif Trail" guides walkers down along the original racing line or to key sections. Interactive stations at the legendary Mausefalle, the Carousel, and the Hausbergkante provide vivid insights into slope gradients reaching up to 85 percent. For leisurely walking circuits around the high plateau, comfortable leisure shoes and standard fitness are entirely sufficient. Ambitious hikers taking on the full walking descent along the Streif down to Kitzbühel (approx. 2.5 hours, 900 vertical meters) require ankle-high hiking boots with deep treads and confident footing on steep grassy slopes.

Visit & Arrival

The Hahnenkammbahn operates in summer from mid-May to late October daily from 08:30 to 17:00; the winter ski season runs from December to April. Tickets can be purchased at the valley station or online, and the ride is included with the Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card. The valley station is located directly within Kitzbühel, with large paid parking areas on site. Train travel is exceptionally convenient: Kitzbühel Hahnenkamm station is situated right opposite the cable car terminal and is served hourly by ÖBB regional and long-distance trains.

Tips

Stand at the original Streif start hut and gaze down into the dizzying drop of the Mausefalle – the view brings home the immense courage of World Cup racers. Afterwards, take a seat on the sunny terrace of the traditional "Hahnenkammstüberl" or "Seidlalm" to enjoy classic Tyrolean Kaspressknödel dumplings.
dauer: Half-day to full-day excursion (walking descent along the Streif approx. 2.5 hours)
preis: Ascent & descent Hahnenkammbahn adults approx. €34.00; Kitzbüheler Alpen Sommer Card valid
oeffnungszeiten: Mid-May to late October daily 08:30 to 17:00; winter ski operations December to April
